title: DRDO & IAF Test 'TARA' Indigenous Glide Weapon System on Jaguar Jet
summary: Tactical Advanced Range Augmentation (TARA) modular kit converts conventional 500kg bombs into precision-guided glide weapons.

blocks.text: 🪝 DRDO & IAF Test 'TARA' Indigenous Glide Weapon System on Jaguar Jet. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: DRDO and IAF flight-tested **TARA (Tactical Advanced Range Augmentation)** modular kit using an IAF Jaguar jet off Odisha, converting 500kg unguided bombs into precision glide munitions.
